description: Tags an object carries so agents and artists know where it belongs, what it is and how its final material should look (ADR-084). An object takes one space tag, one object tag, a material tag, and finish, colour and condition tags when they matter, at most 16 in all. Tags outside this list still apply; tag.list and write operations name them as unknown.

categories.name: space
categories.description: The area the object dresses; it sets the room's palette and wear.

tags.#lab: Research laboratory: clean painted metal, white and grey panels, glass, bright even light.
tags.#office: Administration office: carpet, laminate desks, fabric chairs, warm light.
tags.#lobby: Entrance hall: polished floor, signage, reception desk, brand colours.
tags.#corridor: Passage between spaces: wainscot, skirting, pipes overhead, signage at junctions.
tags.#warehouse: Storage hall: bare concrete, steel racks, painted floor lines, crates.
tags.#workshop: Maintenance and fabrication: oily concrete, tools, workbenches, hazard paint.
tags.#control: Control room: consoles, monitors, dim light, dark panels.
tags.#cafe: Canteen and break room: tile, laminate, warm light, food counters.
tags.#medical: Medical wing: white tile, clean surfaces, green and blue accents.
tags.#transit: Tram and freight lines: concrete tunnels, steel track, sodium light.
tags.#station: Platforms and terminals: concrete, safety lines, benches, timetables.
tags.#maintenance: Service ducts, shafts and plant rooms: bare metal, cables, grime.
tags.#containment: Test chambers and blast zones: heavy steel, hazard stripes, warning lights.
tags.#alpine: Mountain exterior: rock, snow, conifers, weathered concrete and steel.

categories.name: object
categories.description: What the object is; it picks the kind of asset an artist builds.

tags.#trim: Skirting, wainscot, frames and edge strips.

categories.name: material
categories.description: What the final surface is made of.

tags.#concrete: Cast concrete: grey, porous, formwork seams.
tags.#painted_metal: Steel under paint; take the colour tag for the paint.
tags.#bare_metal: Unpainted steel: grey, metallic, mill scale.
tags.#stainless: Stainless steel: bright, metallic, fine grain.
tags.#aluminium: Aluminium: light grey, metallic, soft reflections.
tags.#fabric: Upholstery and cloth: soft, rough, no specular.

tags.#clearcoat: A clear lacquer layer over the base, as car paint or varnished wood.
tags.#brushed: Directional fine lines with stretched highlights (anisotropic).
tags.#perforated: Grating or punched sheet that shows through.

categories.name: color
categories.description: The dominant colour of the final material.

categories.name: condition
categories.description: Wear and dirt the final material shows.

tags.#worn: Edges rubbed, paint chipped where hands and feet go.
tags.#dirty: Grime in corners and on horizontal faces.

categories.name: behavior
categories.description: What the object does in play.

tags.#physics: A dynamic body the player can push.
tags.#mover: Moves or turns on its own.
tags.#climbable: A ladder or a surface the player climbs.
